description: This file is a PHP class implementation for a REST API controller named VacancyRestController within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It handles GET requests to retrieve vacancy details by ID, with placeholders for POST, PUT, and DELETE methods currently raising not implemented exceptions. It manages validation rules and utilizes traits for vacancy services, normalization, and exception handling.

classes.name: VacancyRestController
classes.description: A REST API controller class managing vacancy-related endpoints, primarily supporting retrieval of vacancy details by ID, with placeholders for modification methods. Implements validation, normalization, and exception handling traits.
